fullDesc: In 218 BC Hannibal of Carthage led an army and war elephants over the Alps to invade Italy in the Second Punic War. He beat Rome at Cannae in 216 BC but could not take the city, and Carthage was eventually destroyed in 146 BC.
realFacts: He lost many men and most elephants in the crossing
Cannae is a classic encirclement battle
Scipio Africanus beat him at Zama in 202 BC
